{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 16 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 hole (D12) is a tight fit bore, but the drawing specifies zinc plating (I.Z.B.P.) with no allowance for coating thickness; plating buildup will shrink the bore and cause assembly interference. The designer should either specify masking of the H7 bore before plating or adjust the pre-plate dimension to account for the plating thickness."
  , "recommended_correction": "Add a note specifying that the ⌀16 H7 bore shall be masked during I.Z.B.P. plating, or provide a pre-plate diameter that accounts for the specified plating thickness."}]}
